description: Creates a dynamic hostname such as myhome.dynkite.com. The answer gives the hostname token once (keep it: hostname_update and routers use it). Nothing renews it automatically: give npub to get Nostr reminders before it expires. Paid, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with the price, a Lightning invoice and a Cashu payment request; pay only within what your user allowed, then call again with the same arguments plus l402='<macaroon>:<preimage>', or call with cashu='<token>'. Every request is checked for free before an invoice is made; use check first.

cashu.description: Cashu token (cashuA... or cashuB...) worth at least the price, from an accepted mint (see info). Pays without a previous call.

hostname.description: A label such as myhome (becomes myhome.dynkite.com), or the full name.

l402.description: Lightning payment proof for a retry: '<macaroon>:<preimage>', where macaroon comes from the payment_required answer of the previous call and preimage is the 64-hex proof your wallet returns after paying its invoice. Use it with the same tool and arguments.

npub.description: Optional: a Nostr public key (npub1... or 64 hex) that gets direct-message reminders before the hostname expires, when grace starts and before removal. Reminders only: the key gets no control; managing the hostname still needs its token.

period.description: 30d (30 days) or 1y (365 days). Prices differ: see the tool title.

token.description: Only if you already hold this hostname's token (jdh_...): a create for your own hostname then answers hostname_owned with its expiry and how to renew, instead of hostname_taken.

name: hostname_create
title: Dynamic DNS hostname under dynkite.com (200 sats 30d, 2,000 sats 1y)
